content: सुरभि {%a.%} .²1 Sweet-smelling, fragrant, odorous; पाटलसंसर्गसुरभिवनवाताः <ls>Ś. 1. 3</ls>; <ls>Me. 16</ls>, <ls n="Me.">21</ls>, <ls n="Me.">34</ls>. .²2 Pleasing, agreeable. .²3 Shining, handsome; तां सौरभेयीं सुराभिर्यशोभिः <ls>R. 2. 3</ls>; <ls>Mv. 6. 63</ls>. .²4 Beloved, friendly. .²5 Celebrated, famous. .²6 Wise, learned. .²7 Good, virtuous. .{@-भिः@} .²1 Fragrance, odour, perfume; यः पुरीषसुरभिसौगन्ध्यवायुस्तं देशं दशयोजनं समन्तात् सुरभिं चकार <ls>Bhāg. 5. 5. 33</ls>. .²2 Nutmeg. .²3 Resin of Sāla, or resin in general. .²4 The Champaka tree. .²5 The Śamī tree. .²6 The Kadamba tree. .²7 A kind of fragrant grass. .²8 The season of spring; वासार्थं हर संभृतं सुरभिणा पौष्पं रजो वीरुधाम् <ls>V. 2. 20</ls>. .²9 The month of Chaitra. .²10 The Bakula tree. --{%f.%} .²1 The gum olibanum tree. .²2 The sacred basil. .²3 Jasmine. .²4 A sort of perfume or fragrant plant. .²5 Spirituous liquor. .²6 The earth. .²7 A cow; ऊर्जस्वलेन सुरभीरनु निःसपत्नं जग्मे जयोद्धुरविशालविषाणमुक्ष्णा <ls>Śi. 5. 64</ls>. .²8 <ab>N.</ab> of the fabulous cow of plenty; सुतां तदीयां सुरभेः कृत्वा प्रतिनिधिम् <ls>R. 1. 81</ls>, <ls n="R. 1.">75</ls>; व्यालम्बेथाः सुरभितनयालम्भजां मानयिष्यन् <ls>Me. 47</ls>. .²9 <ab>N.</ab> of one of the Mātṛs. .²10 The east. --{%n.%} .²1 A fragrant smell, perfume, fragrance. .²2 Sulphur. .²3 Gold.
